data.body: **[P2] Avoid re-resolving the path when creating directories.** After securely opening `current`, this call walks the absolute pathname again. A concurrent ancestor rename and symlink replacement can redirect directory creation outside `basePath`; the later relative open may fail, but the external mutation has already occurred. Create components relative to the held directory descriptor, or require the directory tree to be pre-provisioned and only open it through `SecureDirectoryStream`.
